Anita (eng-platform): quick sweep after RCX-512 postmortem — need to lock owners + realistic due dates for the cross-team items. Posting current matrix, pls ack/assign.

Rafi (eng-sre): copying the matrix into thread. can we make at least one owner for the rollout/monitoring items? I can take on canary runbook updates but need eng + product signoff. @Jesse @Maya

Jesse (eng): I can own #3 (traffic-shift playbook) and will aim for EOD Wed. @Anita will that timeline work for the canary window?

Maya (product): EOD Wed is fine for the playbook. I'll review the rollback criteria and send notes by Tue noon.

Anita (eng-platform): ok assigning as follows — if no objections by end of day I'll update the RCA. Current items:

```
1) Update canary runbook — owner: Rafi — due: 2026-03-24
2) Traffic shift playbook + scripts — owner: Jesse — due: 2026-03-25
3) Postmortem docs + exec summary — owner: Maya — due: 2026-03-26
4) Long-tail latency alert tuning — owner: TBD (needs perf lead) — due: 2026-03-30
5) Dependency map (infra -> model serving) — owner: Anita — due: 2026-03-28
```

Rafi (eng-sre): taking 1, will start a PR today. tagging perf folks for #4: @sarah @leo (can you volunteer?)

Jesse (eng): PR for #2 will include the automated rollback snippet. snippet:

```
# quick rollback
curl -X POST https://ops-api/revert -d '{"canary":true}'
```

Maya (product): noted. Also flagging customer comms: we should prepare a short FAQ if the canary hits customers. I'll draft a baseline by Wed.

Anita (eng-platform): two asks:
- if you claim an item, post a comment in the RCA doc with owner + due.
- if an item is blocked, mark with "blocked:" and the reason so we can escalate.

sre-bot: Incident RCX-512 action list updated by Anita. https://redwood.internal/rca/RCX-512 :white_check_mark:

Rafi (eng-sre): acked. PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/runs/987 — starting work, ETA Wed EOD for runbook draft.

Jesse (eng): ack. I'll ping infra for script review by tomorrow.

Maya (product): ack. I'll post comms draft in the doc and run it by sales ops.

Anita (eng-platform): cool. we'll do a quick sync Fri 10am if needed, otherwise status by thread. thanks all :thumbsup:
